reactors.context_query:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') as report_time, (SELECT 'ROOT NODE STATUS:
' || "$producer" || ' (Role: ' || COALESCE(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.identity.role'), 'root') || '): CPU=' || printf('%.2f', CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.cpu.usage_pct') AS REAL)) || '%, Mem=' || printf('%.2f', CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.memory.used_pct') AS REAL)) || '%, Disk=' || printf('%.2f', CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.disk_used_pct') AS REAL)) || '%, MsgCounts=' || COALESCE(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.storage.message_counts_by_type'), '[]') FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'MessageState' AND COALESCE(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.identity.role'), json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.role')) = 'root' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 1) as root_summary, (SELECT group_concat(summary, char(10)) FROM (SELECT "$producer" || ' (' || COALESCE(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.identity.role'), 'node') || '): CPU=' || printf('%.2f', CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.cpu.usage_pct') AS REAL)) || '%, Mem=' || printf('%.2f', CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.memory.used_pct') AS REAL)) || '%, Disk=' || printf('%.2f', CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.disk_used_pct') AS REAL)) || '%, MsgCounts=' || COALESCE(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.storage.message_counts_by_type'), '[]') as summary FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'MessageState' GROUP BY "$producer" HAVING MAX("$when") ORDER BY "$producer" ASC)) as mesh_summary

transformation_expression.subject: 'Report Mesh State (' + string(db.rows[0].fields.report_time) + ')'
transformation_expression.body_text:
'ROOT NODE HEALTH REPORT:

' + (has(db.rows) && size(db.rows) > 0 && db.rows[0].fields.root_summary != null ? string(db.rows[0].fields.root_summary) : 'No root summary available') + '

' + (has(db.rows) && size(db.rows) > 0 && db.rows[0].fields.mesh_summary != null ? string(db.rows[0].fields.mesh_summary) : 'No mesh summary available')
